title: What a mess with widgets..
body:
BUGS APPEARING, BEING FIXED, APPEARING AGAIN. Description below. Watch widget is presented as interactive - not just an icon to launch an app, but in fact they are just different skins of a shortcut. Disappointed as I searched for a convenient and interactive watch interface. UPD as requested by developer: ATracker and Flat Tomato are two interactive I can remember at the moment. By “interactive” I mean that they depict regularly updated data. And two of available options for your app imitate the depiction of variable info (say, progress through the day - rounded scale with a number of how many habits are done today, or round scale with countdown, how many left to do - it always shows 6 ), but they do not work. They either require 10 habits to be active (I had 1-3), or they are just icons, variations of shortcut. UPD2: maybe the issue was with particular watchfaces, or the fix was implemented, but now, with different face, it works.
UPD3: widget is missing again. Doesn’t show on my watch (daily to do and one of daily reports). Deleting the app.
